text: I cannot diagnose multiple sclerosis as it is an autoimmune demyelinating disease of the central nervous system that does not present with liver enlargement, pitting edema, or rapid breathing in a 3-year-old. The clinical picture of hepatomegaly, edema, and tachypnea in a young child strongly suggests congestive heart failure or a metabolic disorder, making MS an impossible and incorrect diagnosis.
